providers.name: OpenCode Go
providers.notice: Go is intended for coding-agent traffic. Confirm your subscription permits HowMuch before use. Retention varies by model; Luna currently has up to 30-day abuse-monitoring retention.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notice: OpenRouter routes requests to model providers. Retention varies by endpoint. HowMuch requests providers that do not collect data for training, but this is not a zero-retention guarantee.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.notice: Uses separately billed OpenAI API access, not a ChatGPT subscription. HowMuch disables response storage; provider abuse-monitoring retention can still apply.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.notice: Uses separately billed DeepSeek API access. Vision Exp is experimental. Review DeepSeek's data policy before sending financial text. Images stay on this device; only extracted text is sent.
